affect. To change how someone feels or how something is.
rain. Water that falls from the clouds in drops.
year. A time of twelve months.
bully. A person who hurts or scares weaker people.
cry. To have tears come out of your eyes.
emotion. A strong feeling like joy, anger or sadness.
sensitive. Quick to notice small changes or to feel hurt.
positive. Looking at the good side of things.
in love. Having strong romantic feelings for someone.
movie. A story shown with moving pictures on a screen.
